text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty ALERT -> automated page fired: inference-router-usw2 5xx-rate spike > 10% (2m window). alert_id=PDT-9142

pagerduty: Page routed to margo-oncall (level1). Escalation timer: 8m.

sophia: acked. looking at graphs now. seeing a jump at 14:02 UTC.

dan: any deploys in the last 10m? I see a router roll to v3.4.1 ~14:00.

ryan: logs show repeated upstream read timeouts from model-router pool. sample: ```
$ curl -i https://inference-router-usw2.internal/health
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Content-Type: text/plain
X-Upstream-Error: read timeout

upstream read timeout
```

sophia: kv-cache eviction also spiked around the same time. cache misses -> higher load on model-router.

margo-oncall: I'm on customer comms (monitoring). handing triage to dan + ryan. loop me for status updates.

dan: rolling router back to v3.4.0 now. will also scale model-router replicas +2.

alice: posted a heads-up to #customers (no full outages reported yet). affected: subset of conversational customers in US-W2 and EU-west routing via that region.

ryan: trying a quick warm-up to prime the model pool (pre-warm requests) and increasing cache TTL to reduce misses.

sophia: applied cache TTL bump to 60s on the hot prefix. watching error rate.

margo-oncall: PagerDuty: please escalate to L2 if error rate > 5% after rollback completes.

dan: rollback finished 14:06. scaling done.

sophia: error rate fell to ~3.8% at 14:07, now ~0.9% at 14:09.

alice: customers 023 and 045 reported transient 502s, they were notified and support engineers pinged.

pagerduty: Page acknowledged and resolved by margo-oncall (manual resolution). escalation timer cleared.

margo-oncall: thanks team. I'll open a follow-up postmortem ticket: suspected root cause = simultaneous router deploy + cache pressure -> cascading upstream timeouts.

sophia: adding logs + flamegraph to the ticket. tagging infra + eng-runtime.

ryan: recommend adding a deploy hold or circuit-breaker for router -> model-router backpressure in the short term.

margo-oncall: agreed. I'll assign action items in the ticket. closing this thread for now :thumbsup:
